title: cenostigma pluviosum var. cabralianum
intro: Cenostigma pluviosum var. cabralianum, commonly known as Cabral's tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Cenostigma pluviosum var. cabralianum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, although the exact composition may vary depending on the source and preparation method.
